fields.label: Modules
fields.name: page_builder
fields.instructions: Content inside modules (gigs, releases, members…) comes from Airtable. These settings only choose what each section shows.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to show the logo / Artist Name from Airtable.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: section_content
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the Tagline from Airtable.

sub_fields.label: Background image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the Hero Image from Airtable.

sub_fields.label: Use Hero Video URL
sub_fields.name: show_video
sub_fields.instructions: Plays the MP4/WebM in Airtable's Hero Video URL behind the title, if set.

sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.name: cta_label
sub_fields.instructions: Blank: automatic Live dates + latest release buttons.

sub_fields.label: Style
sub_fields.name: layout_option
sub_fields.instructions: More styles can be added per module without changing content.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: anchor_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. For links like /#tour.
